_README: Food and drink components checked against the user's logged medications.
Every rule is a verbatim quote from an FDA drug label on DailyMed, found in the label text fetched from openFDA.
A rule has no text of its own: the quote is the whole rule, and nothing here is interpreted.
verified stays false until a person has opened source_url and confirmed the quote; only then may verified_by, verified_on, source_url and source_quote be added and verified set to true.
A rule with no quote and no source must not be added.

rules.quote: Severe liver damage may occur if you take more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours with other drugs containing acetaminophen 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product
rules.applies_to: The label's alcohol warning refers to 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using the product.
rules.citation: FDA label for Pain Reliever Extra Strength, DailyMed set id 0005aafa-08f8-4990-a54d-cc097195708f, warnings section

rules.quote: Stomach bleeding warning : This product contains an NSAID, which may cause severe stomach bleeding. The chance is higher if you: are age 60 or older have had stomach ulcers or bleeding problems take a blood thinning (anticoagulant) or steroid drug take other drugs containing prescription or nonprescription NSAIDs [aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, or others] have 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product
rules.applies_to: The label's alcohol statement refers to having 3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using the product.
